xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4197: Agents page UX overhaul: live-first view of running/in-pipeline work, resizable panes, real state, new color scheme

plan.title: Agents page UX overhaul: live-first view of running/in-pipeline work, resizable panes, real state, new color scheme
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: One page's UX overhaul that the operator asked to run as a single pipeline pass with a mockup-first design and an Opus critic loop: the state tokens, the live-scope API, the live view and the History panes are judged together as one page in light and dark, so splitting them into sibling issues would split that critic loop. The surface is 26 files (2 of them deletions of the orphaned AgentCard primitive and its test); the subsystem count exceeds 6 only because the style guide (design/, sync-sources/), the user doc (reference/), the developer doc (docs/) and the e2e spec (tests/e2e) each count as their own subsystem.

narratives.Problem: /agents opens a Directory that mixes finished and live rows behind an unexplained 24h/7d window, with fixed-width panes. Its Grid view keeps every non-dead strike and labels it STRIKE RUNNING by role alone (FleetAgentsView isFleetAgent + verbBadgeForAgent), so 119 finished strikes render as running while the header says 1 active; Table and Timeline are stubs. The light-gray palette carries no state signal. The operator cannot see at a glance what is running and progressing, what is stuck or needs them, and what waits in the pipeline.
narratives.Proposal: Replace the default /agents content with a Live view fed by a new GET /api/agent-directory?scope=live (derived on read from the pane inventory, state.json pause gates and derived issue state; never stored status). A pure client model classifies each entry into Needs you / Live / Waiting with one worded reason (14-row precedence), enriched in real time with the current tool, last output line and time since output. Rows preview in a resizable, collapsible pane and Open navigates to the live pane or conversation. The Directory stays as the History view behind one link, gaining resizable panes and an explained window. Five system-wide --state-* color tokens (blue live, amber needs-you, red stuck, neutral waiting, emerald done) with a contrast test give the page its color scheme in light and dark. Grid, Table, Timeline and the AgentCard primitive are deleted. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-4197.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing global neutral tokens (--background, --card, --border, ...) or repainting any page other than /agents
- Migrating VerbBadge or other surfaces to the --state-* tokens
- Showing issue trees, plans, PR detail or history browsing inside the Live view
- Showing planned/backlog issues, or issues in derived 'working' state whose agent is not running
- Moving /agents out of the experimental-features gate
- Adding any stored agent status, a new persisted table, or a per-agent governor API
- Changing liveness semantics in src/lib/agents/liveness.ts, services/backend-inventory.ts or deriveServedAgentStatuses
- Committing the .tmp/ mockup or screenshots
- Keeping the Grid, Table or Timeline views behind any flag

autoDecisions.summary: The Live view is built on GET /api/agent-directory with a new scope=live, not a new model or endpoint
autoDecisions.rationale: The directory already derives entry state from the pane inventory on every read and joins agents, conversations, workers, subagents and remote agents; reusing it (and DirectoryDetail for the preview) satisfies 'state from liveness and derived facts' with the least new code.

autoDecisions.summary: Delete the Grid, Table and Timeline views and the AgentCard primitive instead of fixing them
autoDecisions.rationale: The Grid is the graveyard bug and duplicates Command Deck; Table and Timeline are 'Coming soon' stubs; the operator scoped the page to live and waiting only.

autoDecisions.summary: The existing Directory becomes the single 'History' link (/agents?view=history, ?view=directory kept as an alias)
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator allowed 'at most one small link out to the existing history views'; the Directory is that view.

autoDecisions.summary: 'ready' (approved, green PR) is classified Needs you
autoDecisions.rationale: The server-side shipping role prepares merges 'for human merge', so a ready PR waits on the operator.

autoDecisions.summary: CI failed is Waiting with the red tone; scheduler/machine pauses are Waiting ('held by Overdeck'); operator pauses are Needs you
autoDecisions.rationale: Style guide: red = broken, amber = a human must act; CI failures route to the work agent and machine holds clear themselves, only an operator pause needs the operator.

autoDecisions.summary: A single click previews the agent's live transcript beside the list; Open/Enter/double-click navigates to its live pane or conversation
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the Agent Deck live-preview pattern the operator cited while keeping the list in view; the preview is the agent's live conversation.

autoDecisions.summary: Color scheme = five --state-* tokens in :root/.dark with fixed hex values (PRD D8), contrast-tested >= 4.5:1; global neutrals unchanged
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for clear state colors, contrast and dark mode system-wide 'where they apply'; changing global neutrals would repaint every page, outside this issue.

autoDecisions.summary: Mockup goes to the repo-root gitignored .tmp/ and is not committed; it is an implementation checkpoint at the start of live-view, not its own item
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue explicitly says mockups go in gitignored .tmp/; an uncommitted artifact cannot carry an Item: trailer commit.

autoDecisions.summary: Model choice (Opus 5.5 work agent and critic) is recorded in continue.json for whoever starts the work, not enforced by the plan
autoDecisions.rationale: The planner does not spawn the work agent; model selection happens at pan start / the flywheel.

items.title: Add system-wide agent state color tokens with a contrast test

expected_outputs: state-tokens-contrast.test.ts passes with one assertion per foreground token per surface

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1 (.pan/drafts/PAN-4197.md). In src/dashboard/frontend/src/index.css add the ten --state-{live,needs-you,stuck,waiting,done}[-foreground] tokens to :root (light values) and .dark (dark values) exactly as the PRD D8 table gives them, right after --signal-cost-foreground in each block. In the '@layer utilities' badge block add .badge-bg-state-<s> (8% color-mix), .badge-border-state-<s> (32%), .text-state-<s> (color: var(--state-<s>-foreground)) and .bg-state-<s> (background: var(--state-<s>)) for all five states. Re-point DirectoryStateBadge TONE: working->state-live, blocked->state-needs-you, stuck and api-error->state-stuck, done->state-done, idle->state-waiting; stopped/remote/no-status unchanged. Add src/dashboard/frontend/src/__tests__/state-tokens-contrast.test.ts that parses index.css (:root, first .dark, [data-theme="broadsheet"], .dark [data-theme="broadsheet"] blocks; hex and hsl() values) and asserts every --state-*-foreground has WCAG contrast >= 4.5 against the NFR-1 surfaces and that --state-live/-foreground hue is outside 90-170 degrees. Document the state tokens (token, meaning, always/never, running is never green) in design/style-guide/STYLE-GUIDE.md and sync-sources/dev-skills/pan-style-guide/SKILL.md (never .claude/skills).

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4. Create src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/Agents/live/live-model.ts (pure; no React, no store import) exporting the types and functions listed in the PRD (LiveSection, LiveTone, LiveReasonKind, LiveReason, LiveFacts, LiveRow, LiveSections, LIVE_QUIET_AFTER_MS = 5 min, classifyEntry, buildLiveSections, activityLabel, lastOutputLine). classifyEntry applies the 14-row precedence table in the PRD exactly (first match wins; 'issue agent' = kind agent + issueId + role work|strike). buildLiveSections nests kind==='subagent' entries under the row whose entry.id equals parentId (dropping orphans) and sorts needsYou ascending by since (missing last), live and waiting descending, ties by id. lastOutputLine returns the last non-empty ANSI-stripped line truncated to 160 chars with an ellipsis. Tests in live-model.test.ts per PRD WI-4.
